name: testsprite
description: Unofficial. Steering layer for the TestSprite CLI: set up a repo, audit coverage, verify changes before 'done', and gate CI. Honest about what TestSprite can and cannot test (web, HTTP APIs, hosted MCP; not stdio MCP servers or CLI binaries).

interface.shortDescription: Set up, audit and verify with the TestSprite CLI
interface.longDescription: An unofficial judgment layer around the TestSprite CLI: check fit first, set a repo up, audit a suite, get a real verdict before calling a change done, gate CI, and say plainly when a repo is not a fit. Guards billable and destructive commands. Brings its own skills; installs no MCP server.
